map.保费减赔款减费用 使用指南: Premium Minus Claims Minus Expenses — User Guide
map.输入保费收入、赔款支出与各项费用，按承保利润 = 保费 − 赔款 − 费用计算保: Enter premium income, claim payments and expenses to compute underwriting profit as premium − claims − expenses, for profitability analysis by line of business or institution.
map.直接三差法：保费减赔款减费用得承保利润。: The direct three-difference method: premium minus claims minus expenses gives underwriting profit.
map.保费 1000 万、赔款 650 万、费用 250 万: Premium 10,000,000 CNY, claims 6,500,000 CNY, expenses 2,500,000 CNY
map.：承保利润 = 1000−650−250 = 100 万。即承保端利润 100: : underwriting profit = 1000−650−250 = 1,000,000 CNY, i.e. underwriting profit of 1,000,000 CNY, a 10% margin.
map.由年给付与年金因子求净单保费: Net Single Premium from Annual Annuity and Annuity Factor
map.由总赔款与索赔件数求平均赔付额: Average Claim Amount from Total Claims and Claim Count
map.一致：(1000−650−250)=100万 = 1000×(1−0.9)=10: Consistent: (1000−650−250)=1,000,000 CNY = 1000×(1−0.9)=1,000,000 CNY; at CR=90% the two methods are equivalent.
map.承保利润为负但公司还赚钱？: Can underwriting profit be negative while the company still earns?
map.可能。承保亏损可由投资收益弥补（利差益），这是保险商业模式核心。但若连续承保巨亏: Yes. Underwriting losses can be offset by investment income (the spread gain), which is the core of the insurance business model. But sustained large underwriting losses that investment income cannot cover are a warning sign.
